title: Japan Lost 1.6 Million Vending Machines And Still Leads
hook: Japan lost 1.6 million vending machines and still seems covered in them.
closing: Convenience survives the decline because Japan still keeps machines close to nearly everyone.
question: What should a machine sell?

segments.say: Japan lost 1.6 million vending machines. Even after that retreat, machines remain embedded in daily life.
Japan keeps one vending machine for every 31 people. The United States is less than half as dense.
About 2.2 million Japanese machines sell beverages. Hot and cold drinks keep the network useful year-round.
